content.text: The opening ceremony of the 22nd staging of the games will be attended and officially opened by the Princess Royal, Princess Anne, and will be hosted by broadcaster Lorraine Kelly.
For Annelise, this will be her first island games. She says lots of hard work has gone in to getting here.
Mr Ottley: 'What an ambassador she is for the sport,' he said. 'We want to see more girls come into this sport.'
